title: Imaging, Virtual Care, and Patient-Generated Data
summary: The blueprint areas the original eight modules left thin: enterprise imaging (DICOM, PACS, VNA, IHE), telemedicine and virtual care, remote patient monitoring and patient-generated health data, FHIR Bulk Data and patient-facing APIs, and the FDA SaMD / 21st Century Cures CDS exemption / ONC HTI-1 DSI regulatory stack for AI-enabled clinical software.
learningOutcomes: Read a DICOM workflow at the level of modality worklist, C-STORE, query/retrieve, and explain where the PACS, VNA, and EHR each sit.
Name the IHE profiles that govern cross-enterprise imaging exchange (XDS-I, PIX, PDQ, ATNA, XUA) and explain what each one does.
Distinguish telemedicine modalities (synchronous video, store-and-forward, RPM, e-consult) and the regulatory constraints that apply to each (DEA Ryan Haight, state licensure, parity laws).
Explain how FHIR Bulk Data ($export) differs from per-patient FHIR API access and which use cases require which.
Apply the four 21st Century Cures Act criteria for the CDS-not-a-device exemption and identify when an AI-enabled tool is regulated as FDA SaMD.
Describe the ONC HTI-1 DSI requirements (2024) for predictive decision support intervention transparency.
